For every fixedb in(0,1), withR=(1+sqrt b)/(1-sqrt b), c_m(b)~(1-b)^2 R^(2m-1)/(8pi b) asm tendsinfinity. This is not asserted uniformly for movingb.

The positive increasing functionsF_N(b)=c_m(b)(1+b^N) have the correct fixedb<1 limitc_m(b), whileF_N(1-1/N)/c_m(1-1/N) approaches1+e^-1. Thus even monotone fixed-prefix limits do not imply a moving-prefix relative asymptotic.
